Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.filtering_policies
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access filtering policies, by action.

Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.forwarding_profiles
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access traffic-forwarding profiles, by traffic type and state.

Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.onboarding_status
Metrics.Description: Global Secure Access onboarding status (0 = onboarded, 1 = in progress, 2 = error/offboarded, -1 = unmapped). See docs/signals.md.

Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.packet_tagging_enabled
Metrics.Description: Whether Global Secure Access cross-tenant network packet tagging is enabled (1) or not (0).

Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.remote_networks
Metrics.Description: Count of Global Secure Access remote networks configured for the tenant.

Metrics.Name: entra.gsa.signaling_enabled
Metrics.Description: Whether Global Secure Access data-plane signaling to Conditional Access is enabled (1) or not (0).
